title: Conservation-law discovery from trajectories alone: exact recovery on new test systems, calibrated rejection boundary, and a symbolic zero-dF/dt certificate
problem: Given only trajectory samples (no force model), discover conserved quantities and know when none exists.
hypothesis: Nullspace/SVD discovery on feature increments F(s_{k+1})-F(s_k)=0 recovers Duffing energy and planar angular momentum exactly (multiple trajectories required), rejects damped/forced controls by preregistered spectral criteria, and yields a machine-checkable symbolic certificate dF/dt = grad F . f_hat == 0.
baseline: AI Poincare (Liu & Tegmark, PRL 126, 180604, 2021, arXiv:2011.04698) -- same increment formulation via LP; Liu et al. PRE 109, L023301 (2024) SVD nullspace variant; ConservNet (Ha & Jeong 2021)
proposed_improvement: No method novelty (prior art found in audit). Increments: (a) replication on double-well Duffing + central-force system whose energy is non-polynomial (only Lz recoverable -- verified); (b) measured detectability boundary vs damping (delta>=0.005 undetectable at preregistered thresholds); (c) SymPy-certificate artifact with rational snapping guarded by data-fit checks.

experimental_evidence.result: cos-angle to H direction 1.000000000000, affine R2=1.0, resid/range(H)=2.0e-9, held-out conservation ratio 2e-9, detected=True

experimental_evidence.what: angular momentum recovery (energy provably outside library)

experimental_evidence.result: damped(delta=.3)/forced(F=.5) correctly rejected; boundary between delta=0 and delta=0.005
discovered F=-v^2-x^4/2+x^2, field v'=x-x^3+x, dF/dt expands to exactly 0 -> CERTIFIED

adversarial_attacks: single-trajectory degeneracy identified (spurious nulls) and fixed by multi-energy sampling
ill-posed within-trajectory normalization replaced by cross-energy conservation ratio
novelty_notes: Core method published (AI Poincare 2021; SVD variant 2024). Our additions are calibration + certificate + negative-control protocol; labeled replication-level novelty.
proof_status: experimentally_validated_result (certificate itself is formally machine-checked for the fitted model)
